## 2. Uncertainty when the template is the unit of generalisation

Study 01 resampled seeds and tasks. A claim about *unseen templates* needs templates resampled too. Both intervals are 95%.

| config | eval_ood mean | reported CI (seeds, tasks) | CI resampling seeds and the 16 templates |
|---|---|---|---|
| B | 30.3 | [23.9, 37.5] | [16.8, 44.9] |
| C | 30.3 | [23.9, 36.8] | [13.9, 48.3] |
| Dmix | 35.6 | [29.2, 42.8] | [19.4, 52.9] |
| Dseq | 32.8 | [27.4, 38.6] | [17.5, 49.4] |
| teacher | 56.2 | [50.0, 62.5] | [38.3, 73.3] |

## 3. What training covered

- Training pool: 3000 tasks from 24 templates, **23 distinct gold-graph signatures**.
- `eval_ood`: 16 signatures, 12 of them absent from training.
- Tools that are gold in at least one training task: 13 of 17 that appear in training catalogues. Never gold, only distractor or fallback: book_flight, issue_refund, search_flights, weather_backup.
- `eval_ood` templates that need a tool never used as gold in training: 4 of 16.
- `eval_id` tasks per template range from 1 to 13 (the verbatim-overlap filter removed most instances of low-entropy templates).

## 5. Smallest detectable difference between two arms

`se^2 = 2*seed/S + arm_family/F + 2*seed_family/(S*F) + 2*within/(S*F*m)` for F held-out families, S seeds per arm, m tasks per family, both arms scored on the same tasks. Detectable difference = 2.80 x se (two-sided 5%, 80% power). The last column is the non-inferiority margin that a truly equal pair passes with 80% power (2.49 x se, one-sided 5%). Inputs from section 4: seed x family variance 0.0253, within-cell variance 0.101. The residual seed sd is not distinguishable from zero on `eval_ood`, so two assumed values are shown.
